title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane.
